assumptions: The command user may supply invalid policy values and an inaccessible directory.
validations: Parse policy values before orchestration and translate boundary failures into the published outcome families.
trust_boundaries.trust_ceases_at: Typed results cease to be trusted when rendered for an external consumer.

assumptions: A clock implementation may fail or return only whole-second instants.
validations: Translate host failures and expose only the typed Instant value through the port.
trust_boundaries.trust_ceases_at: The instant is revalidated whenever a different clock implementation crosses the port.

assumptions: Directory contents may change concurrently and each host filesystem call may fail.
validations: Translate host entries into validated immutable values and translate every filesystem failure at the adapter boundary.
trust_boundaries.trust_ceases_at: A previously listed entry loses its trust when a later filesystem operation begins.

data_classes.retention: Held only for one command invocation; the application persists no copy.
data_classes.redaction: Caller-owned entry names are deliberately returned in plans and typed failures but are never written to an independent log sink.

sensitive_data_absence: The worked reference intentionally handles no credential, personal, confidential, or secret-bearing data class.
